name: type-wall
title: Type Wall
description: Rows of one word fill the frame, run in alternating directions at different speeds in heavy, narrow and outline faces, with an accent band through the middle.
useWhen: A loud full-screen beat for one word, such as a section title, a manifesto word or a transition card.
A busy, graphic backdrop behind a short overlay that should read as pure energy.
Kinetic poster typography should run for as long as the scene needs.
avoidWhen: One strip of scrolling text is enough, as a ticker or a separator: use infinite-marquee.
The rows should recede in perspective rather than fill the frame flat: use perspective-marquee.
A single word should stay readable at the center with quieter repeats: use echo-stack.
author: Remocn
